Correction to the 2026 national title note above: USA Shooting's official championship report names Rachel Tozier as the 2026 Women's Trap National Champion; Skinner was named to the Open National Team at those championships

Made a children's book with children at a Gulu, Uganda orphanage during her Spring 2018 Momentum trip, each drawing representing a letter of the Acholi alphabet
Teaches as a middle school art teacher at Salmon River Central School, scaffolding art instruction from sixth to eighth grade
